title: Pure Agent dependencies, canonical policy and explicit I/O adapters
requirements: Only contracts.models defines BotPolicy; production, scheduling and tests use the canonical composite without an obsolete service alias.

Agent imports no outer implementation layer, SQLite or HTTP client. EmotionSystem consumes an injected repository; concrete store and builder move to infrastructure and feature composition with unchanged tables and dedupe behavior.
MemoryService never creates embedding HTTP clients from environment; bootstrap builds and closes the explicitly injected adapter while deterministic local embeddings remain in Agent.
Migrate test imports and policy fixture construction without reducing test cases or assertions. Runtime/unraisable coroutine warnings block full regression.
